usage.source_scope: Pure deterministic mechanism check informed by closed Commons multi-facet diagnostics; no real successor cohort opened.
usage.project_application: Replace scene-level identity AND entrance gating with candidate-specific target-to-entrance edges before tracking and guidance.
usage.modifications: Use expanded proposal context, a public target roster, harmonic entrance/identity edge evidence, set-valued ambiguity, and fail-closed search.
usage.expected_effect: Recover true entrances whose whole-scene identity is weak while rejecting generic high-score doors belonging to a different nearby entity.

evaluation.claim_boundary: The mechanism check passes generic-distractor, wrong-target-only, and same-target-twin cases. Real-image gain, exact entrance pixels, navigation, arrival, product, user-benefit, and safety remain unproved.

history.change: Next fresh run must evaluate proposal-context features directly; do not reopen V1/V2 or tune their thresholds.
